page.overview:
Who is Metro City Thugs?

Common thugs with a mask that use basic attacks. They appear in three shapes. Two of them wear white shirts without sleeves, but one of them has grey jeans and a dark mask, and the other one appears with blue jeans a and light mask. The third wears a black shirt and white trousers. Sometimes they appear with a Bat. The actual name these hoodlums like to go by is unprintable, most people refering to them as the "MCT" (Metro City Thugs). Though they mostly hail from Kyle's Hood, they can often be found kicking up trouble in other parts of Metro City.

Names: (also used for muscular Glow Heads with knives) {|

Common thugs wearing a bucket hat. They appear in four shapes, being one with a dark green shirt, one with a dark shirt without sleeves, one with a white shirt, and one a brown shirt. All use basic attacks. The weakest type gives a kick to fallen enemies. Stronger types can do a jump attack or throw knives. They can also have pistols, but only as a part of side quests, but not randomly in the streets. Like the thugs with masks, they are found in several parts of Metro City, and the two often appear together.

The Punx make up one of the more "structured" gangs of Metro City. They are a band of punks that only roam in the Pier District. However, they more resemble a sort of skinheads with primitive mohawk haircut, rather than "classic" punks as we used to imagine them. They are always in groups, not mixed with any other type of thugs. Each group has its own designated leader, and they are always looking for blood.
